name_zh: 卡里莫夫/乌兹别克斯坦/独裁/安集延/棉花/石油/伊斯兰/塔什干

description_zh: 伊斯拉姆·阿布加富·奥加耶夫（1938-2016）是乌兹别克斯坦总统（1990-2016）。长期执政，实行独裁统治。2005年安集延事件导致国际谴责。乌兹别克斯坦以棉花和石油经济闻名，他推动了伊斯兰化政策。
description_en: Islam Abduganiyevich Karimov (1938-2016) was President of Uzbekistan (1990-2016). Long-term dictatorial rule. 2005 Andijan事件 led to international condemnation. Uzbekistan known for cotton and oil economy, he promoted Islamization policies.
reason_zh: 卡里莫夫的治理智慧体现在资源控制和独裁统治中。通过棉花和石油经济实现国家稳定。通过伊斯兰化政策控制部落和宗教。继任危机是其执政的挑战。
reason_en: Karimov's governance wisdom exemplified in resource control and dictatorial rule. Through cotton and oil economy, achieved national stability. Islamization policies controlled tribes and religion. Succession crisis was challenge of his rule.
